description: Puzzle catalog for the LaCrema jigsaw app. Consumed by index.html (?puzzle=<id>) and the demo launcher (demo/index.html). Difficulty combines piece count with how visually distinctive the artwork's regions are.

puzzles.title: Crema Swirl — LaCrema Classic
puzzles.artStyle: warm coffee crema swirl with latte art
puzzles.notes: Flagship demo puzzle on the app's default 4x6 grid. Self-contained artwork, works offline.

puzzles.title: Aurora — Original Remote Artwork
puzzles.notes: The artwork the app originally hardcoded. Needs internet access and CDN availability - use aurora-ridge for offline or CI runs. Also exercises the remote-image code path.

puzzles.title: Aurora Over the Ridge
puzzles.artStyle: night sky, aurora ribbons, mountain silhouettes
puzzles.notes: Offline stand-in for the original aurora artwork. Dark regions in the sky are the tricky part.

puzzles.title: Sunny Day Friends (Kids)
puzzles.artStyle: bright flat shapes, thick outlines, high contrast
puzzles.notes: Six chunky pieces and every region is visually unique - ideal first puzzle and quick mobile demo.

puzzles.title: Sunset Dunes
puzzles.artStyle: layered dunes, big sun, gradient sky
puzzles.notes: Large distinct color bands make orientation obvious. Good warm-up before the 24-piece grids.

puzzles.title: Botanical Afternoon
puzzles.artStyle: line-art plants on cream, terracotta accents
puzzles.notes: Light background with sparse line work - moderate ambiguity in the empty regions.

puzzles.title: City Nights
puzzles.artStyle: night skyline, lit windows, water reflections
puzzles.notes: 54 pieces. Window grids repeat locally but each building has its own light color.

puzzles.title: Terrazzo Floor
puzzles.artStyle: repeating terrazzo shards with a few large accents
puzzles.notes: 96 pieces over a repeating pattern - many near-identical pieces. The large accent shards are the only anchors.

puzzles.title: Morning Mist
puzzles.artStyle: low-contrast fog gradient, one tiny bird
puzzles.notes: Deliberately uniform artwork: 40 pieces that all look alike. Tests player tolerance and how much the snap/connect ergonomics help.

puzzles.title: QA: Minimal 1x2
puzzles.notes: Smallest sensible grid - two full-height slabs. Smoke test for grid math and instant solves.

puzzles.title: QA: Single Column 6x1
puzzles.notes: Degenerate single-column grid (cols=1). Pieces span the full canvas width.

puzzles.title: QA: Stress 150 Pieces
puzzles.notes: Performance stress: 150 pieces of 53x120 px. Watch drag frame rate - findConnectedPieces is O(n^2) per move - and Organize behavior.

puzzles.title: QA: Broken Image URL
puzzles.notes: Image intentionally 404s. The app must show the friendly image-load error instead of hanging on a blank canvas.
